Field.Label: Controls Dometic CFX5 coolers over the local Wi-Fi network (no cloud, no Bluetooth). Each cooler is an Indigo thermostat-type device: the cool set-point is the cooler's set-point, "Cool" mode is compartment power on and "Off" is off, and the cooling indicator follows the compressor. The cooler must already be joined to your Wi-Fi. A DHCP reservation for the cooler is recommended; the plugin also re-finds a cooler by its id via mDNS when its address changes.

Field.tooltip: Seconds to wait for a TCP connection before treating the cooler as unreachable (2-30). Coolers that are switched off simply time out.
